versions.subject: Create proc_creation_win_susp_secedit.yml (#3725)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\secedit.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'SeCEdit'
selection_flags_discovery:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/export'
        - '/cfg'
selection_flags_configure:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/configure'
        - '/db'
filter:
    SubjectUserName|endswith: '$'
condition: selection_img and (1 of selection_flags_*) and not filter
versions.spl: Image="*\\secedit.exe" OR OriginalFileName="SeCEdit" (CommandLine="*/export*" CommandLine="*/cfg*") OR (CommandLine="*/configure*" CommandLine="*/db*") NOT SubjectUserName="*$"
